title: Countable open extension products in independent coefficient universes
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme in universe $t$, and let $U$ be an object of its small pro-etale site whose structure morphism $j$ is a quasi-compact open immersion [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-open-immersion]. Put $v=\max(u,t+1)$. Let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings with section sets in universe $v$, write $R_0$ for its underlying sheaf of rings, and use $v$-sized module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every family $(M_n)_{n\in\mathbf N}$ of module sheaves over $R_0|_U$, the canonical comparison
$$e_!\left(\prod_{n\in\mathbf N}M_n\right)\longrightarrow\prod_{n\in\mathbf N}e_!M_n$$
is an isomorphism. Here $e_!$ is the actual direct-sum extension presheaf followed by module sheafification, namely localizedSystemExtension [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact]; the comparison is Mathlib's piComparison, characterized by its composites with every product projection. No equality between $u$ and $t$, and no quasi-compactness or separation hypothesis on $X$, is imposed.

source.place: Tag 09BP (lemma-j-shriek-limits), kernel proof; module refinement with arbitrary ring sheaf, using the existing ringed recollement and closed-immersion limit nodes.

proof.text: Use the normalized localized adjunction. Since U is subterminal, Over.forget U is full. The counit of slice restriction followed by its right adjoint is invertible sectionwise. Mathlib's adjoint-triple criterion makes the unit of L adjoint J invertible. J preserves countable products as a right adjoint. Projecting J(piComparison L M) onto each factor identifies it, after these unit isomorphisms and the J product comparison, with the product of the unit components. Hence J(piComparison L M) is invertible.

Take the actual reduced induced closed subscheme of the complement of U. Let I be module forgetful followed by its constructed abelian inverse image. Closed inverse image preserves countable products by the independent-universe closed theorem; module forgetful preserves products because module-sheaf limits are sectionwise. Every I(L(M n)) and I(L(product M)) is zero by the support theorem. Therefore both source and target of I(piComparison L M) are zero, so it is an isomorphism.

Apply the complementary-restriction isomorphism detection clause of the support theorem to the two mapped comparison isomorphisms. This proves the original canonical comparison is invertible, with the original statement and all universes unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09BP via the original open-closed argument. F5: adjoint-triple proof of the open unit, product projection calculation, closed abelian product comparison, and complementary support detection. The two independent geometric refinements are named separate nodes.

        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)} RingCat.{max u (t + 1)})).obj R).over U)) :
